reference_devices.android: Vivo Y19 (Android 12 / API 31, MediaTek Helio P65, 8 GB RAM, 60 Hz LCD)
reference_devices.ios: iPhone 11 (iOS 17, A13 Bionic, 4 GB RAM, 60 Hz LCD) up to iPhone 16 Pro (A18 Pro, 120 Hz ProMotion OLED)

ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.large_blur_usage: ZERO. Pure tonal container surfaces and hairline borders; zero RenderEffect blurs.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.alpha_compositing: MINIMAL. Only subtle text gradient scrims on photo cards.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.animated_gradients: ZERO. Flat, contrast-tested Material 3 color roles.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.lottie_rive_dependencies: ZERO. Native VectorDrawables and standard Compose animations.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.map_video_concurrency: AVOIDED. Map never plays inline video simultaneously; media detail launches as distinct view.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.image_memory_footprint: OPTIMAL. WebP decode sized to display viewports via Coil image loader with RGB_565/ARGB_8888 caching.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.nested_scrolling_complexity: LOW. Standard LazyColumn containing LazyRow filter chips.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.recomposition_risk: LOW. Stable immutable UI state classes and Kotlin collections.

ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.alpha_compositing: ZERO. Solid backgrounds with sharp borders.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.image_memory_footprint: LOWEST. Small thumbnails; minimal cache pressure.

ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.large_blur_usage: MODERATE. Frosted dialogs and stone texture blending.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.alpha_compositing: HIGH. Multi-layer overlapping terracotta and parchment surfaces.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.map_video_concurrency: RISKY. Background ambient loop behind translucent map.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.nested_scrolling_complexity: HIGH. Parallax header combined with nested horizontal carousels.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.recomposition_risk: HIGH. Parallax scroll offsets trigger frequent recompositions.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.material_stacking: CONTROLLED. Only standard system navigation bar and tab bar materials (.bar).
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.video_map_concurrency: ZERO. Distinct view controllers; map and video player never run simultaneously.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.large_image_decode: CONTROLLED. AsyncImage downsamples to exact frame dimensions.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.continuous_animations: ZERO. Motion only on active user gesture or transition.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.three_d_lifecycle: STRICT. Curated SceneKit/RealityKit view teardown when dismissed.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.sheet_map_conflict: ZERO. First-party presentationDetents managed cleanly by UIKit/SwiftUI.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.material_stacking: MODERATE. Multiple thin material cards over continuous MapKit canvas.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.video_map_concurrency: MODERATE. Thumbnail preview loops on top of moving map.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.continuous_animations: HIGH. Continuous GPS camera tracking and floating heading arrow.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.sheet_map_conflict: MODERATE. Gesture conflicts between drawer drag and map pan.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.material_stacking: HIGH. Multiple layered frosted glass sheets and glass buttons.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.video_map_concurrency: HIGH. Frosted glass over playing video loop.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.continuous_animations: HIGH. Real-time blur recalculation during scrolling.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.sheet_map_conflict: HIGH. Blur shader passes during sheet drag cause frame drops on older GPUs.
